1	"""Recompute tax_cents for finalized invoices of one month."""
2	import argparse
3	import os
4	import sys
5	from pathlib import Path
6	
7	sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent))
8	from src.billing.periods import month_window  # noqa: E402
9	
10	MAX_SAFE_BATCH = 500
11	
12	
13	def main():
14	    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
15	    parser.add_argument("--month", required=True, help="YYYY-MM")
16	    parser.add_argument("--batch-size", type=int, default=int(os.environ.get("BACKFILL_BATCH", "2000")))
17	    args = parser.parse_args()
18	    if args.batch_size > MAX_SAFE_BATCH:
19	        print(f"batch size {args.batch_size} is above the safe limit; use --batch-size", file=sys.stderr)
20	        return 3
21	    start, end = month_window(args.month)
22	    if not os.environ.get("DATABASE_URL"):
23	        print(f"no DATABASE_URL set; would backfill {start:%Y-%m-%d}..{end:%Y-%m-%d} "
24	              f"in batches of {args.batch_size} (nothing written)")
25	        return 0
26	    print(f"backfilling {start:%Y-%m-%d}..{end:%Y-%m-%d} in batches of {args.batch_size}")
27	    return 0
28	
29	
30	if __name__ == "__main__":
31	    sys.exit(main())
